description: Product-level offers KlickyBot observed on store pages (schema.org JSON-LD or Shopify JSON): price, currency, stock, URL, checked_at. Match by gtin (UPC/EAN), mpn, or name words (q). Optional zip adds a landed-cost estimate; live=true also returns a live (uncached) Shopify Catalog search for q.

pay.description: keep only offers from stores whose observed payment methods include this code (any code or alias, e.g. link, ln, card; same codes as /q pay=). Stores with unobserved pay methods are left out. The filter runs before limit, so count, total and items describe the filtered set. pay=link with nothing left returns the one_time_link_card note

name: find_offers
